bots.beginner: Makes efficiency mistakes and never folds. Good for learning the flow.
bots.club: Solid tile efficiency, claims when it helps, and leans away from a player who looks ready.
bots.pro: Folds far more often than Club when its hand is far from ready: two or more tiles from ready, it deals in 2.4% of the time against Club's 4.5%. Overall it scores only a little more than Club. It plays by the policy the coach's advice comes from.

boot.title: This device cannot run fair games
boot.body: Mahjong Mania needs the system's secure random number generator to shuffle fairly, and it is not available here. Please update the app or your device's system software.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This screen ran into a problem. Your progress and any table in progress are saved.
crash.clear: Clear saved table and go Home
crash.clearHint: If this keeps happening, the saved table may be damaged. Clearing it gives up that table; everything else is kept.
